acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing RPG World, you agree to comply with these terms. This software is provided by Rebs Tech Studio "as is", without warranties of any kind.

conduct.title: 2. User Conduct
conduct.content: RPG World is a space for creativity and fun. It is strictly prohibited:
items: Publishing content that promotes hate, racism, or any form of discrimination.
Using the system for spam or illegal activities.

content.title: 3. User Content
content.content: You retain ownership of all stories and characters created. However, by using our platform, you grant us a worldwide, royalty-free license to store and display this content solely for game operation.

donations.title: 4. Donations and "Buy me a coffee"
donations.content: Financial contributions are voluntary donations to support development. They do not constitute the purchase of services, do not grant ownership rights over the software, and are non-refundable.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: We are not responsible for data loss, connection errors, or service interruptions. As the code is open source (GPLv3), you have the right to host your own instance if you wish for full control over your data.

age.title: 6. Minimum Age and Child Protection
age.content: RPG World is intended for users who are at least 13 years old. We do not intentionally collect data from children under 13. If we become aware that a minor under 13 has provided us with personal data, we will take steps to delete such information and close the account.

updates.title: 7. Changes to the Terms
updates.content: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. We will notify users about significant changes through system notices or by email. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

law.title: 8. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
law.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil. Any dispute will be resolved in the jurisdiction of the city of São José dos Campos, SP, with express waiver of any other.

gameContent.title: 9. Game Content and Credits
gameContent.content: The rules and spells shown in RPG World come from open sources, used under their licenses. The attributions of the System Reference Documents are reproduced exactly as Wizards of the Coast asks:
items: This work includes material taken from the System Reference Document 5.1 (“SRD 5.1”) by Wizards of the Coast LLC and available at <srd>https://dnd.wizards.com/resources/systems-reference-document</srd>. The SRD 5.1 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License available at <ccby>https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode</ccby>.

This work includes material from the System Reference Document 5.2 (“SRD 5.2”) by Wizards of the Coast LLC, available at <srd52>https://www.dndbeyond.com/srd</srd52>. The SRD 5.2 is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License, available at <ccby>https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode</ccby>.

The Spanish spells and conditions of the 2014 rules come from the official Spanish edition of the SRD 5.1: Esta obra incluye materiales extraídos del Documento de referencia del sistema 5.1 (“SRD 5.1”) de Wizards of the Coast LLC, que está disponible en <srdEs>https://dnd.wizards.com/es/resources/systems-reference-document</srdEs>. El SRD 5.1 tiene la licencia Creative Commons Atribución/Reconocimiento 4.0 Licencia Pública Internacional, que está disponible en <ccbyEs>https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.es</ccbyEs>.

The structured data of the 2014 spells was obtained from the <api>5e SRD API</api>, from the <database>5e-bits/5e-database</database> project, under the MIT license. The 2024 spells were extracted from <fivetools>5etools</fivetools>, only the entries that are part of the SRD 5.2.

The Brazilian Portuguese spell translations come from the <foundry>D&D 5e translation module for Foundry VTT</foundry> by the Foundry VTT Brasil community (Cauã Pessoa and contributors), under the MIT license.

Full credits and license texts are in the repository's <notice>NOTICE.md</notice> file.

data.title: 1. Data Collected
data.content: We collect only what is essential for your experience:
items: Account: email and password (the password is stored encrypted by <supabase>Supabase</supabase>) or, if you sign in with <google>Google</google>, the email and name of your Google account.
Profile: username, avatar and preferred color.
Characters: sheets, backstory, learned spells and the images you upload.

Parties: name, picture, rules edition, who is GM and player, invitations, the characters brought along, the party inventory and the journal link (a Google Docs document the GM picks; the content stays with Google, not in RPG World).
Support: email, type and message, when you use the contact form.

Technical data: when you visit the site, <vercel>Vercel</vercel> and <supabase>Supabase</supabase> log the IP address, browser and requested pages, for security and error diagnosis. On protected forms, <cloudflare>Cloudflare Turnstile</cloudflare> checks the IP and browser signals to tell people from bots. To count visits we use <cloudflare>Cloudflare Web Analytics</cloudflare>, which uses no cookies and does not identify you: it only records aggregate numbers, such as page views and load times.

usage.title: 2. Data Usage
usage.content: Your data is used exclusively to:
items: Keep you signed in and protect your account.
Save your characters and sync them across devices.
Send account emails (sign-up confirmation and password reset) and reply to your support messages.

sharing.title: 3. Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your data to third parties. To run RPG World we use these services: <supabase>Supabase</supabase> (database, sign-in and image storage), <vercel>Vercel</vercel> (hosting), <resend>Resend</resend> (email delivery), <cloudflare>Cloudflare Turnstile</cloudflare> (bot protection on sign-up, the magic link, password reset and the contact form; and anonymous visit counts, with Cloudflare Web Analytics), <discord>Discord</discord> (where the support team receives the messages sent through the contact form: email, type, message and, if you are signed in, your account id) and <google>Google</google> (only if you sign in with Google). Your profile (username and avatar) and a summary of the characters you bring to a party (name, avatar, race, class and level) are seen by the people in that party; the GM also sees the sheet of those characters. In a party without a GM, an active player can become the GM with the agreement of all the other active players and, from then on, sees the sheets of the party's characters. Someone who does not answer that request can be removed from the party by support, after an email and 7 days without a reply, and that person's characters leave the party with them. The journal link and the party inventory are seen only by the GM and active players. The party name and picture show to anyone with the invite link, even without an account (that's what Discord and WhatsApp display when the link is pasted). Everything else stays visible only to you; avatar images are stored at a public address that is not listed anywhere.

rights.title: 4. Your Rights
rights.content: In accordance with <lgpd>LGPD</lgpd>/GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, or delete your data. You can delete your account at any time in Settings > Profile: you enter your username and password (if you only signed in with Google there is no password step) and we send a confirmation link to the account's email, valid for 1 hour. After the final button, deletion is immediate and cannot be undone. For your other rights, or if you cannot delete from there, contact us through the <support>support form</support> or on <server>Discord</server>; we reply within 5 business days.
deletionItems: Your login, profile, characters and NPCs are deleted, with everything they hold. The images you uploaded lose their owner and a daily job removes them within 2 days; cached copies can last up to 1 day.

Parties where you are GM: if there are active players, the party stays with them and has no GM; without active players, the party is deleted. A party without a GM loses its picture and any ongoing combat. In other people's parties, your membership is deleted and your characters leave them.
What you put in the party chest and the journal link stay with the party.

In feedback, we remove your email and the link to your account; the text, type and date remain, and the text may contain what you wrote in it. Copies of messages sent to support on Discord and the text of feedback are deleted if you ask.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies
cookies.content: We only use necessary cookies: the ones for your sign-in session, the language you chose and your time zone. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

transfer.title: 6. International Data Transfer
transfer.content: To operate the system, we use third-party infrastructure: <supabase>Supabase</supabase>, <vercel>Vercel</vercel>, <resend>Resend</resend>, <cloudflare>Cloudflare</cloudflare>, <discord>Discord</discord> and, only if you sign in with Google, <google>Google</google>. As a result, your data may be processed and stored on servers located outside of Brazil, specifically in the United States. This transfer is necessary to provide the service you asked for when you created the account (<lgpd>LGPD</lgpd>, art. 33, IX, combined with art. 7, V) and is carried out under strict security and encryption standards.

retention.title: 7. Data Retention and Deletion
retention.content: Your data remains stored in our database as long as your account is active. If your account remains inactive for more than 24 months, we reserve the right to perform automatic deletion for security and resource saving.

contact.title: 8. Contact and Data Controller
contact.content: For any questions regarding your privacy or to exercise your rights (<lgpd>LGPD</lgpd>), talk to the team through the <support>support form</support> or on our <server>Discord server</server>. For matters about your account, prefer a direct message to the team over the public channels.

seo.title: RPG World: free D&D 5e character sheets
seo.description: Free, open-source app to create and manage D&D 5e character sheets, with automatic calculations and an SRD spellbook, in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
seo.ogImageAlt: RPG World logo next to a D&D 5e character sheet and a glowing purple d20

features.highlightsSubtitle: The sheet does the math, the spellbook has the SRD spells, the party brings GM and players together, and everything works in English and Portuguese.
features.metaDescription: Everything RPG World does today: a D&D 5e character sheet with automatic calculations, a searchable SRD spellbook, inventory, parties with real-time combat and a journal, in English and Portuguese.
features.title: Everything you can do in RPG World
features.subtitle: Free, open source and no account needed to look around. Create one when you want to build your first character.

journal.mobileNotice: On a phone the journal opens straight in Google Docs. To edit it in here, use a computer.

mine.title: My characters at the table
mine.description: Choose who you bring. You can change it any time.
mine.leaveConfirm: Leave this party? Your characters stay with you.
mine.leaveConfirmLastPlayer: You are the last active player of this party, which has no GM. If you leave, the party is deleted, with its chest and journal. Leave anyway?

gmClaim.title: This party has no GM
gmClaim.description: The GM’s account was deleted. The party, characters, chest and journal still work; combat, invites and settings wait for a new GM.
gmClaim.claim: I want to be the GM
gmClaim.claimHint: Everyone else in the party has to agree. The GM reads the full sheet of every character at the table. You stop being a player and your characters leave the party, keeping their sheets.
gmClaim.claimHintSolo: You are the only active player, so you become the GM right away, with no one to agree. The GM reads the full sheet of every character at the table. You stop being a player and your characters leave the party, keeping their sheets.
gmClaim.claimConfirm: Ask to be the GM? If everyone agrees, you stop being a player and your characters leave the party, keeping their sheets.
gmClaim.claimConfirmSolo: Become the GM of this party now? You stop being a player and your characters leave the party, keeping their sheets.
gmClaim.limit: You are already the GM of {max} parties, the most one account can have.
gmClaim.yourRequest: You asked to become the GM of this party.
gmClaim.askedBy: {name} asked to become the GM of this party.
gmClaim.sheetWarning: If you agree, the new GM will read the full sheet of the characters at the table, yours included.
gmClaim.supportLater: Available one day after the request, for whoever hasn’t answered.
gmClaim.supportHint: Support writes to whoever hasn’t answered and gives them 7 days before stepping in.

chest.title: Party inventory
chest.coinsHint: The party's money. The GM and the players can change it; saved right away.
chest.itemsHint: What the party keeps together. The GM and the players can add and remove; saved right away.
chest.emptyHint: Add what the party keeps together: treasure, supplies, items found along the way.

image.title: Party picture
image.hint: Shown on the invite and when someone pastes the link on Discord or WhatsApp. Anyone with the link sees the party name and picture, even signed out.
image.empty: No picture: the link shows the RPG World image.

enemies.subtitle: Sheets for everyone who isn't a player: enemies in your parties' combats, and anyone else in the story.
enemies.createFirstDescription: Create a sheet to use as an enemy in combat. Several enemies can share one sheet.
enemies.newDescription: Pick the name and the system. You fill in the numbers on the sheet.

combat.title: Combat
combat.noCombat: No combat going on. Prepare one to set up the initiative order.
combat.empty: Nobody in the combat yet. Add the party's characters and the enemies.
combat.endCombatConfirm: End the combat? The order and the enemies' HP will be lost.
combat.reconnecting: Reconnecting… the screen updates by itself when the connection is back.
combat.playerPreparing: The GM is preparing the combat.
combat.gmTurn: The GM is running this turn

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.pickerDescription: Turn on the conditions affecting this creature.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.intro: Deleting your account is permanent and cannot be undone. This will erase:
dangerZone.erasesCharacters: All your characters and NPCs, with everything on them
dangerZone.erasesImages: Your images, such as avatars (they are removed shortly after)
dangerZone.keptTitle: Parties that stay without a GM
dangerZone.keptHint: Their active players can still use them and choose a new GM.
dangerZone.lastPlayerTitle: Parties without a GM where you are the last player
dangerZone.partiesError: We could not load your parties, so we cannot show what the deletion affects.
dangerZone.dialogDescription: First we confirm it is you, then we e-mail you a link. Nothing is deleted until you confirm there.
dangerZone.passwordHelp: If you signed in with an e-mail link before, you have a password you never saw. Set a new one with “Forgot my password”.
dangerZone.sentDescription: We sent a link to the e-mail of your account. It works once and for 1 hour. Your account is only deleted when you confirm there.
dangerZone.sendAgainHint: Sending again makes the previous link stop working.

confirm.title: Confirm account deletion
confirm.description: You are about to permanently delete the account <bold>{username}</bold>, with its characters, NPCs and images. This cannot be undone.
confirm.descriptionNoName: You are about to permanently delete your account, with its characters, NPCs and images. This cannot be undone.
confirm.invalidDescription: It has expired, was already used or was replaced by a newer one. Request a new one in your profile settings.

demo.notice: Meet the women who inspired a world of adventure. This collection celebrates remarkable women from history, science, technology, literature, and leadership through original fantasy reinterpretations. Each character is inspired by a historical figure, but her abilities, equipment, adventures, and fictional biography belong to the RPG World fantasy setting. These characters are fictional tributes, not historically accurate portrayals or official endorsements.

banner.text: The Pioneers demo: you are exploring a read-only campaign.

invite.title: Make your own adventure
invite.description: The demo is read only. Create a free account to build your characters, join a party and save your progress.
